L.label: Low
L.detail: Uses the least redundancy and can still scan if about 7% of the symbol area is damaged or covered.

M.label: Medium
M.detail: Balances capacity and resilience, with recovery for about 15% of damaged or covered area.

Q.label: Quartile
Q.detail: Spends more of the code on correction data, allowing recovery from about 25% damage or occlusion.

H.label: High
H.detail: Uses the most correction data, so the code can often survive about 30% of its area being obscured.
